value.0: A trial altar of black stone sits on the west side of the forge floor. A hammer-scarred shield hangs above it, and the warden who keeps it answers any challenge struck against it.
A trial altar in the north-west of the caverns, ringed by burned-out votive braziers. Prayers are carved into the stone in an old Sith hand, and someone still tends them.
A spear rack stands before a trial altar, its weapons cold-forged and unadorned. The stone around it is strangely dead to the touch, as if the Force itself has been worn away.
